📊 What moved today, Wednesday 11 November

📉 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.1% lower at 105,558.
💱 The rand weakened for a second day to about R16.61 to the dollar, the day after hotter-than-expected US inflation data.
⛽ Brent oil rose 1.7% to about $93 a barrel; gold slipped 0.6%.

What it means for you: a weaker rand and dearer oil work against December's expected petrol price cut. The official petrol price is announced at the end of the month.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
